title: Pikachu Pals Go to Camp
description:
Traverse to catch them all in a new cobblemon let's play! Updated to 1.21.1 for Cobblemon 1.7.3! Over 250 mods and new world with Legendary Survival Overhaul! Now with megas and legendaries that spawn!

Several cobblemon addons to enhance your experience!
body:
# Pikachu Pals Go to Camp

**Server is now open with a camping theme!**

![Pikachu Pals Go to Camp](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a521f4fccbc0c31bbb9c90ddc4554664c0cfefad_0.webp)

This epic Cobblemon survival gameplay welcomes all players. When you join, you will arrive in Pikachu Pals Spawn. Everyone will have a starter kit.

1. Build and be inspired by so many mod decorations!
2. You can set up to 4x homes and use warp scrolls for additional homes. 
2. Check out the NPC campers at spawn for tutorials.  
4. So many cobblemon mod addons including complete Cobblemon collection and legendary spawns! 
5. Modpack may require 6-8gb to play.
6. Reactive music jor's Cobblemon Music Pack included

# 🌲 [Wild Camps](https://modrinth.com/mod/w-wildcamps)
Adds immersive campsites to world genration with over 300 varieants with loot

# ⛏️ [Cobblemon MMO Skills](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-mmo-skills)
Adds mcMMO-style leveling, abilities, guis, and leaderboards for gathering, combat, and cobblemon progression. Use /mmoskills and other skill shortcuts 

# 💰 [CobbleDollars Command Shop](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobbledollarscommandshop)
Create custom shops with categories and offers per-player stock for limited offers 

# 📒 [Cobblemon Cards](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-cards)
Collect cards, fill your album with over 100 custom cards and gain extra perks for your character.

# 💫 [Shiny Notifications](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-spawn-notification)
Never miss a shiny again!

# ⚔️ [Punchy](https://modrinth.com/mod/punchy-fpa)
Adds various first person animations and visible hands with held items!

# 🍹 [Legendary Survival Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-survival-overhaul)
Temperature, thirst, limbs management, health overhaul for survival game!*Note: less annoying and nerfed to make server game play more fun. Being well fed heals player automatically, instead of instant damage in extreme heat or cold, player loses thirst overtime. New juices, mod integration with other food mods, canteens, water plants, ice box, and heater will help you. Bonus hearts and shield hearts help with new challenging difficulty.Use the sewing table to apply insulated armor on any modded gear. Use transmog to make further cosmetic changes as you like.
